body:
There's no difference in JS between:

``` js
var obj = {
  ['facet']: ['lang'] // computed property name resolving to 'facet'
}
```

[Computed properties](https://developer.mozilla.org/en/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Operators/Object_initializer#Computed_property_names)

and

``` js
var obj = {
  'facet': ['lang']
}
```

or

``` js
var obj = {
  facet: ['lang'] // no need for '' since no special character
}
```

They all resolve to the same object structure.

The original issue and description is not what we are looking for, open a new issue if you remember the exact problem.
